title: The first Nvidia RTX Spark mini PCs launch today from Asus, Dell, and MSI
description: After the first RTX Spark laptops launched earlier this year, Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X chip is also now available in desktops from Asus, Dell, and MSI. More RTX Spark desktops are coming later from Acer, Gigabyte, and HP, while Microsoft's Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is slated to start shipping this month. The new mini […]
